scope: One continuous whole-arc overview of the received 120-chapter version from the spirits prologue to the death of Song Jiang; 70- and 100-chapter alternatives are not silently combined.
editorial_boundary: Narrative follows a 120-chapter primary Chinese witness. Edition-dependent long ending distinguished from Jin Shengtan’s shorter one. No claim of historically verified outlaw biographies or exhaustive independent Chinese critical collation.
